ingredients.name: water
ingredients.description: Fundamental base for dissolving active ingredients and hydrating skin.

ingredients.name: glycerin
ingredients.purpose: Deep hydration and moisture barrier preservation
ingredients.description: Potent humectant that attracts ambient water to the stratum corneum, restoring suppleness.

ingredients.name: niacinamide
ingredients.purpose: Pore tightening, barrier repair, and sebum balance
ingredients.description: Essential water-soluble vitamin that calms redness, fades hyperpigmentation, and strengthens epidermal lipids.

ingredients.name: hyaluronic acid
ingredients.purpose: Intense cellular plumping and hydration retention
ingredients.description: Naturally occurring glycosaminoglycan capable of binding up to 1,000 times its molecular weight in water.

ingredients.name: ceramide np
ingredients.purpose: Restores and reinforces damaged stratum corneum barrier
ingredients.description: Identical to human skin lipid structure, prevents transepidermal water loss and protects against environmental irritants.

ingredients.name: squalane
ingredients.description: Hydrogenated form of squalene; non-comedogenic oil that prevents lipid moisture loss.

ingredients.name: tocopherol
ingredients.purpose: Free radical neutralization and lipid stabilization
ingredients.description: Protects cosmetic formulation oils from rancidity while providing cellular antioxidant defense.

ingredients.name: fragrance
ingredients.flag_reason: High incidence of contact dermatitis, allergic sensitisation, and hidden phthalates
ingredients.description: Proprietary chemical mixture commonly associated with contact allergies, barrier disruption, and headache triggers in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: methylparaben
ingredients.flag_reason: Endocrine disruption concerns and weak estrogenic mimicry
ingredients.description: Synthetic ester used to inhibit bacterial and fungal proliferation; flagged in modern clean beauty regulations for potential bioaccumulation.

ingredients.name: sodium lauryl sulfate
ingredients.flag_reason: Severe protein denaturation and lipid barrier stripping
ingredients.description: Effective cleansing agent but known to disrupt cutaneous lipid bilayers, causing dryness, redness, and scalp irritation.

ingredients.name: sodium laureth sulfate
ingredients.description: Gentler ethoxylated variant of SLS, generally well tolerated unless contaminated with ethoxylation byproducts.

ingredients.name: dmdm hydantoin
ingredients.description: Slowly decomposes to release micro-doses of formaldehyde to kill microbes; known trigger for contact dermatitis.

ingredients.name: phenoxyethanol
ingredients.purpose: Widely tolerated preservative alternative to parabens
ingredients.description: Effective antimicrobial agent approved globally at concentrations under 1%.

ingredients.name: cetearyl alcohol
ingredients.description: Non-drying fatty alcohol that gives creams silky consistency and conditions skin.

ingredients.name: dimethicone
ingredients.purpose: Occlusive protective barrier and slip agent
ingredients.description: Forms a breathable physical seal over the epidermis to prevent moisture evaporation without suffocating skin.

ingredients.name: salicylic acid
ingredients.purpose: Lipophilic pore clearing and comedone dissolution
ingredients.description: Penetrates lipid-rich sebaceous follicles to dissolve debris and soothe inflammatory acne.

ingredients.name: butylated hydroxytoluene
ingredients.flag_reason: Synthetic preservative linked to organ toxicity and skin sensitivity
ingredients.description: Synthetic antioxidant widely substituted in modern formulations due to bio-persistence and endocrine questions.

ingredients.name: phthalates
ingredients.description: Commonly concealed under generic 'Fragrance' labels, associated with hormonal imbalance.

ingredients.name: citric acid
ingredients.purpose: pH balancing and mild AHA radiance
ingredients.description: Natural alpha hydroxy acid used primarily to balance cosmetic formulations to skin's optimal acidic pH (~5.5).

ingredients.name: xanthan gum
ingredients.description: Non-irritating plant-fermented polysaccharide that stabilizes emulsions and enhances texture.
